headline: US online spending hits record 7 billion dollars on Thanksgiving day
label: NEWS
caption:
US online shoppers spent a record breaking amount during the holiday. 🛍️

According to Anadolu, US online spending reached a record 7.1 billion dollars on Thanksgiving.

Consumers flocked to digital platforms to secure holiday deals and discounts.
